description:
Adds a payroll wage item. Each payroll wage item describes and names a payment scheme, for example, Regular Pay or Overtime Pay. A PayrollItemWageRef aggregate refers to one of these wage items. In a request, if a PayrollItemWageRef aggregate includes both `full_name` and `list_id`, `full_name` will be ignored.

The `payroll_item_wage_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3100 name_in_use, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

expense_account_ref.description: Refers to an expense account. If an `expense_account_ref` aggregate includes both `full_name` and `list_id`, `full_name` will be ignored.

full_name.description: The record's name, parents first: `Jones:Kitchen:Cabinets`. Not case-sensitive.

list_id.description: QuickBooks' ID for the record. Used over `full_name` when both are sent.

include_qbxml.description: Also return the qbXML this compiles to, for debugging. Not part of the v2 request.

is_active.description: If `is_active` is true, this object is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks. The default value is true.

name.description: Description of the wage: for example, Regular Pay or Overtime Pay.

request_id.description: Your own label for the request, sent to QuickBooks as its qbXML `requestID` and echoed in the raw answer (`response_xml`); optional, since the answer's webhook already carries the request's `id`.

headers.description: Send with the request. Resent unchanged when no 201 came back, it answers with the request already queued.

qbxml.description: The qbXML it compiles to. Only with include_qbxml.
